content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD simple case single_vessel_short_channel. No PROGRAM statement; the unit opens with declarations (L1-4) and terminates with a bare END (L44). It reads 7 grid/geometry parameters in fixed order from 'bathy_param.txt' (Mglob, Nglob, DX, DY, dep_channel, width_channel, slope; L9-15), allocates Mglob x Nglob arrays DEPTH, X, Y (L18), initializes uniform depth Depth(I,J)=dep_channel and Cartesian coordinates with Y centered on the channel axis via Y(I,J)=(J-Nglob*0.5)*DY (L20-26), then in a second loop pair (L28-35) reduces depth linearly outside the half-width: where abs(Y(I,J))>width_channel*0.5, DEPTH = dep_channel - slope*(abs(Y)-width_channel*0.5) (assignment on L31 with continuation on L32), producing a flat channel of width width_channel flanked by linearly shoaling side slopes. Finally writes DEPTH row-by-row (J outer, I inner implied loop, L38-40) to 'depth.txt' under FORMAT 9000f12.6 (L41).
entities: DEPTH — REAL, DIMENSION(:,:), ALLOCATABLE, declared L1, allocated L18
X — REAL, DIMENSION(:,:), ALLOCATABLE, declared L1, allocated L18
Y — REAL, DIMENSION(:,:), ALLOCATABLE, declared L1, allocated L18
I — INTEGER loop index, declared L2
J — INTEGER loop index, declared L2

equations.ref: side-slope depth; continuation L32 completes: slope*(abs(Y(I,J))-width_channel*0.5)

unresolved: bathy_param.txt column meanings are fixed only by read order (L9-15); no comment in this file documents units of DX/DY/slope
FORMAT 9000f12.6 (L41) caps one output record at 9000 values while the WRITE implied loop runs I=1,Mglob (L39); behavior for Mglob>9000 (record wrapping) is not addressed in this file
